style.vernacular: Humid coastal capital: low and mid-rise concrete frame buildings finished in whitewash or pastel-painted render, deep verandahs and overhanging eaves, red half-round clay tile hip roofs on colonial and Bawa-era buildings, flat concrete roofs with water tanks on newer blocks, and glass towers rising along the Beira Lake and Galle Road corridors. Heavily weathered, mildew-streaked walls and coconut palms and rain trees everywhere.
style.ornament: Colonial (Dutch and British) arcaded verandahs, Corinthian porticos and pediments on civic buildings; Kandyan-style tiered tile roofs, carved timber pillars and moonstone/lion motifs on monuments and temples; Geoffrey Bawa tropical-modernist courtyards, colonnades and pools; whitewashed dagobas and bo-tree shrines.

sources.what: Dutch and British colonial buildings (Palladian/neoclassical/neo-baroque) in Colombo, Bawa tropical modernism with terracotta-tiled roofs, colonnades and pools
neoclassical civic building with Corinthian columns and dome
